request.description:
Create Message

Summary  
Creates a new message in a direct message (DM) chat.

Method & URL  
POST [http://localhost:8085/message](http://localhost:8085/message)

Request Body (application/json)  
{  
"sender": "string (UUID)" – Required. The unique ID of the user sending the message.  
"content": "string" – Required. The message text content.  
"chat_id": "string (UUID)" – Required. The unique chat/conversation ID the message belongs to.  
"chat_type": "string" – Required. The chat type; for DMs use "dms", for GROUPS use "groups" and for THREADS use "threads".  
}

Purpose  
Create a new user in the local user service.

Endpoint

- Method: POST
    
- URL: [http://localhost:8085/use](http://localhost:8085/user)
    

Request Body  
Provide JSON with the following fields:

- fullname (string): Full legal name of the user. Example: "Alice Johnson"
    
- username (string): Unique username (slug-safe). Example: "alice"
    
- email (string): Valid email address. Example: "[alice@example.com](https://mailto:alice@example.com)"
    

Example

``` json
{
  "fullname": "Alice Johnson",
  "username": "alice",
  "email": "alice@example.com"
}

 ```

Sample Success Response (Illustrative)

``` json
{
  "id": "b123f5c0-9d2e-4c61-9a6a-8a2d1c0f3a4e",
  "fullname": "Alice Johnson",
  "username": "alice",
  "email": "alice@example.com",
  "createdAt": "2025-01-01T12:34:56.000Z"
}

 ```

Purpose  
Create a new group.

Method and URL  
POST [http://localhost:8085/group](http://localhost:8085/group)  
Schema:  
{  
"gp_name": string, // Required. Human-readable group name. 1-64 chars.  
"created_by": string, // Required. UUID (v4) of the user creating the group.  
}

Validation Rules

- gp_name: required, non-empty, max 64 characters.
    
- created_by: required, must be a valid UUID string.

item.name: add members to group by id

request.description:
Summary  
Add a user as a member of a group. Creates or updates the membership record identified by gp_members_id and associates it with a user (gp_members_user_id) with the specified role.

Endpoint  
POST [http://localhost:8085/group/member](http://localhost:8085/group/member)

Method  
POST

Schema  
{  
"gp_members_id": "string (UUID)",  
"gp_members_user_id": "string (UUID)",  
"role": "string"  
}

Field descriptions

- gp_members_id (required): Unique identifier of the group membership record. Typically a UUID generated by the server or client to ensure idempotency.
    
- gp_members_user_id (required): Unique identifier of the user to add to the group.
    
- role (required): Role to assign to the user within the group. Common values: "member", "admin"
    

column_3 in request body represents user role in a group

Summary  
Create a new discussion thread within a group.

Endpoint  
POST http://localhost:8085/thread

Description  
Creates a thread resource that users can post messages to. The request requires a valid group ID and the user ID of the creator.

Path and Variables

- baseURL (variable): Base API URL provided by your selected environment.
    

Request Body  
Content-Type: application/json  
Schema  
{  
"thread_name": string, // Required. Human‑readable title of the thread.  
"created_by": UUID string, // Required. The user ID creating the thread.  
"gp_id": UUID string, // Required. The group ID the thread belongs to.  
"column_4": string // Optional. Default may be public. thread can be either public or restricted  
}

column_4 represents the visibility of the thread

Purpose  
Adds a user as a member to an existing thread.

Endpoint  
POST {{baseURL}}/thread/member

Method  
POST

Path Params  
None. The endpoint does not take path parameters.

Request Body  
Content-Type: application/json (raw)  
Schema:  
{  
"thread_members_id": "string (UUID)", // Unique identifier for the thread membership record to create or upsert  
"thread_members_user_id": "string (UUID)" // The user to be added to the thread  
}  
Field details:

- thread_members_id (required): UUID for the new membership entry. If your backend auto-generates IDs, provide rules accordingly.
    
- thread_members_user_id (required): UUID of the user to add as a member of the thread.

Summary: Initiates a direct message (DM) thread between two users.

Purpose: Use this endpoint to create a new DM conversation for a user pair.

Method & URL: POST [http://localhost:8085/dm](http://localhost:8085/dm)

Request Body Schema (JSON):  
{  
"column_1": string, // UUID of the first participant  
"column_2": string // UUID of the second participant  
}

column_1 and columnS_2 represent user1_id and user2a_id respectively

Validation Notes:

- user1_id and user2_id must be valid UUIDs.
    
- They should represent two distinct users.

Purpose  
Retrieve a single message resource by its unique message_id.

HTTP

- Method: GET
    
- URL: {{baseURL}}/message/:message_id
    

Path parameters

- message_id (string, UUID): The unique identifier of the message to fetch. Example: 5f3618ce-56f3-4751-8f30-c76ff0a5f256

Overview  
Fetches all direct messages (DMs) for a specific chat (conversation) identified by chat_id.

Method & URL  
GET [http://localhost:8085/message/dm/:chat_id](http://localhost:8085/message/dm/:chat_id)

Path variables

- chat_id (string, required): The unique identifier of the DM conversation to retrieve messages for.
    

Usage notes

- Ensure chat_id belongs to a DM conversation; other conversation types may be unsupported by this endpoint.

Purpose  
Retrieve all messages in a specific thread within a group.

Endpoint  
GET {{baseURL}}/message/thread/:threadId

Path Parameters

- threadId (UUID, required): The unique identifier of the message thread. Example: 7016044e-20ab-4edd-afa0-84b7a8de2370

Retrieves all messages for a specific group chat.

- Method: GET
    
- URL: {{baseURL}}/message/group/:chat_id
    
- Path params:
    
    - chat_id (UUID): The unique identifier of the group chat.
        

Successful response (200): An array of message objects. Example:

``` json
[{
  "chat_id": "2a2370d1-d733-4f1f-8488-c2fd290deb75",
  "chat_type": "groups",
  "sender_name": "Bob Smith",
  "message": "Welcome to the Developers group!",
  "time_sent": "04:26 PM",
  "day_sent": "2025-11-29"
}]

 ```

Notes:

- Ensure chat_id corresponds to an existing group.

Path parameters
